info.name: Get all new event keys since resume token

params.name: resumeAt
params.description: token that designates the point to resume from, that is find keys added after this point

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of events to return, default is 100. The max with data is 10000.

params.name: includeData
params.description:
Whether to include the event data (carfile) in the response. In the future, only the payload or other options may be supported:
  * `none` - Empty, only the event ID is returned
  * `full` - The entire event carfile (including the envelope and payload)
